claims.claim: SpaceX selected Qualcomm Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 platforms for Starlink Mobile 5G base stations.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX chose Qualcomm's Dragonwing QRU100 and QDU100 platforms plus Layer 1 software to equip Massive MIMO radio units with 64 transmit and 64 receive paths.
claims.source_title: Qualcomm Dragonwing Selected for SpaceX Starlink Mobile Nationwide 5G Network
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX selected Qualcomm's Dragonwing cellular infrastructure platforms to power Starlink Mobile's U.S. nationwide terrestrial 5G network, covering tens of thousands of base station sites beginning in 2027.

claims.claim: Norway awarded a NOK 450 million framework agreement for Starlink access through July 2033.
claims.episode_span: Norway’s Defence Materiel Agency signed a framework agreement worth up to NOK 450 million (C$68 million) that runs through July 2033 and includes Starlink service.
claims.source_title: Norway’s Military and Police Gain Starlink Access Under C$68 Million Deal
claims.supporting_quote: the framework agreement is worth up to NOK 450 million (C$68 million) and covers commercial satellite communications services through July 2033.

claims.claim: Musk stated orbital AI data centers could become cheaper than ground facilities in 30 to 36 months.
claims.episode_span: Musk posted that data centers in space now look appealing following Democratic control of both congressional chambers and growing state-level opposition to new terrestrial facilities. SpaceX has filed with the FCC to deploy up to one million solar-powered satellites for orbital computing, with Musk estimating orbital AI costs could fall below ground equivalents in 30 to 36 months.
claims.source_title: Elon Musk Proposes Space Data Centers as Democratic Victory Raises Concerns Over AI Infrastructure
claims.supporting_quote: Musk believes orbital AI computing could become cheaper within 30 to 36 months.

claims.claim: SpaceX acquired roughly 65 MHz of mid-band spectrum from EchoStar and up to 14 MHz of low-band spectrum from Grain Management.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX acquired roughly 65 MHz of mid-band spectrum from EchoStar and up to 14 MHz of low-band spectrum from Grain Management to support the build.
claims.source_title: SpaceX moves to challenge AT&T, Verizon with Qualcomm-powered 5G
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX has assembled substantial spectrum holdings for this purpose: roughly 65 MHz of mid-band frequencies acquired from EchoStar (including AWS-4 and related bands) and up to 14 MHz of low-band 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management.
